# Axiom audit — Armada Transact circuit model (armada-lean)
# Generated by: lake env lean /tmp/axioms_check.lean  (Lean 4.33.1, core Lean only, no mathlib)
#
# Poseidon is modeled symbolically (Dolev-Yao style, ArmadaLean.Poseidon.Term), not
# axiomatized: `poseidon2`, `poseidon3`, `poseidon2_inj`, `poseidon3_inj` do not exist
# in this project. `Term.hash2`/`Term.hash3` are plain, computable definitions over an
# inductive term type; their collision resistance (`Term.hash2_inj`/`Term.hash3_inj`) is
# a proved theorem, from the type's constructors, not an assumption.
#
# Expected axioms:
#   EdDSAVerify — CRYPTOGRAPHIC ASSUMPTION: EdDSA signature validity predicate
#       (unforgeability assumed, not modeled).
#   propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound — Lean core logic axioms (benign, part of
#       the trusted kernel logic).
# No 'sorryAx' anywhere: zero sorry/admit in the project.
# `msgHashOf` (Transact.circom:163-175, Poseidon(2+N+M) over the public inputs) is no
# longer an axiom either: it is defined directly as a `Term.hash` call over the
# circuit's own input packing, since `Term.hash` already represents a Poseidon call of
# any arity.

== transact_value_conserved ==
(Finding 1 fix: in-field sumIn === sumOut at Transact.circom:141-143 is a true
integer equality, given Num2Bits(120) range checks :120-129 and N ≤ 8, M ≤ 4.)
'transact_value_conserved' depends on axioms: [EdDSAVerify, propext, Quot.sound]

== transact_no_double_spend ==
(Finding 2 fix: pairwise leaf distinctness :145-161 lifts to pairwise-distinct
published nullifiers :97-101 via Term.hash2's collision resistance, proved by
construction — ArmadaLean.Poseidon.)
'transact_no_double_spend' depends on axioms: [EdDSAVerify]

== merkleRoot_inj_leaf ==
(A Merkle membership proof binds exactly one leaf to the root; with the root
check at Transact.circom:95 a proof cannot be moved to a different commitment.)
'merkleRoot_inj_leaf' does not depend on any axioms.

== no_wraparound_minting ==
(Range-checked sums below 2^120 with ≤ 8 inputs / ≤ 4 outputs stay below the
BN254 prime, so fieldEq of sums implies integer equality. Pure arithmetic:
depends only on Lean's core logic axioms, no cryptographic assumptions.)
'no_wraparound_minting' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

== user_npk_ne_contract_npk ==
(ArmadaLean.TransactOwned, the Dolev-Yao domain-separation theorem: a user's
note key, built from a `Term.hash` master public key, can never equal a
contract's note key, built from a `Term.val` address — by construction,
`Term.noConfusion`, no cryptographic assumption needed.)
'user_npk_ne_contract_npk' does not depend on any axioms.

# Note: transact_value_conserved / transact_no_double_spend mention EdDSAVerify only
# because their statements quantify over the `Constrained` constraint structure, which
# itself references that symbol (the circuit's signature check, `Constrained.sig`); the
# value/double-spend arguments themselves use only the range-check, distinctness, and
# Term.hash2_inj facts, none of which are axioms.
